# Check isoforms for HORMAD1 and INPP5K
for gene, acc in [("HORMAD1", "Q86X24"), ("INPP5K", "Q9BT40")]:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json").json()
    comments = r.get("comments", [])
    isoforms = []
    for c in comments:
        if c.get("commentType") == "ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS":
            isoforms = c.get("isoforms", [])
    print(f"=== {gene} ({acc}) ===")
    print("Canonical mass:", r.get("sequence", {}).get("molWeight"))
    if isoforms:
        for iso in isoforms:
            print("Isoform:", iso.get("name"), iso.get("isoformIds"), iso.get("sequenceStatus"))
    else:
        print("No alternative products recorded.")

from Bio import SeqIO
import io

for gene, acc in [("HORMAD1", "Q86X24"), ("INPP5K", "Q9BT40")]:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta?includeIsoform=true")
    records = list(SeqIO.parse(io.StringIO(r.text), "fasta"))
    print(f"=== {gene} ===")
    for rec in records:
        pa = ProteinAnalysis(str(rec.seq))
        mw = pa.molecular_weight()
        print(f"{rec.id}: {len(rec.seq)} aa, {mw:.1f} Da, {mw/1000:.1f} kDa")
